radiusSource: Radius 0.677 +/- 0.027 solar radii from Mayo et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-136 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..235M/abstract): 470,989 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.742 +/- 0.039 solar masses from Mayo et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-136 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..235M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4500 +/- 125 K from Mayo et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-136 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..235M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
